Please note that we do have availability as requested,

Check-in: 02nd July
Check-out: 04th July
Nb. of nights: 02 nights

Nb. of rooms:04 Bedroom + maid room

Location: Seaside Hills Residences

Non-refundable rate: 4,396.99AED

We have a deposit of 2000 AED to be paid upon check-in.

Please note that your refundable damage deposit should be reimbursed within 14 working days of your check-out. Your deposit will be refunded in full by credit card or bank transfer, subject to an inspection of the property.

Our standard check-in time is between 3 pm and 9 pm; if the apartment is ready, we will happily provide you with an early check-in. If you arrive after 9 pm, we will provide you with a self-check-in.

We wanted to gently remind you that, unlike hotels, our holiday homes at fäm Living are located in residential buildings & Areas which belong to landlords who let out their properties to you on a short-term basis and through Fäm Living. There are no hotel-like services such as daily housekeeping, breakfast, or reception.
Please find below our website link for more information about our apartments at Seaside Hills Residences

https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1632444947335450111?guests=1&adults=1&s=67&unique_share_id=7f936f00-97a2-4f0e-abc3-655d924cf3b1

Please advise if you would like to proceed accordingly.

Regards,
